content.title: Fox starts it, Red Lions finish it in extra-time drama
paragraphs: Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time, with Fox setting the tone early by scoring in the 28th minute from Lane's assist. Red Lions kept pushing through a game that stayed tight all the way, and Reid struck in the 95th minute after Rook's pass to put Red Lions back in front at 2-1.

Blue Sharks refused to go away, with Gray leveling in the 62nd minute and Cruz equalising again in the 105th minute. The turning point came in the 113th minute, when Bell's own goal restored Red Lions' lead for good. Fox's night also stood out beyond the goal: the Red Lions captain kept getting on the ball, reached 100 completed passes in the 116th minute, and finished with a strong all-around shift.

Red Lions controlled the match for most of the night, especially in the last 10 minutes, when Red Lions had nearly all the territory and possession. The numbers back that up: Red Lions had 27 shots to Blue Sharks' 15, and 110 entries into the final third, so the pressure finally told.
